en.title: Fine-Tuning Won't Teach Your Model Your Docs: RAG vs Fine-Tuning
en.subtitle: Training on your documents teaches how they sound, not reliably what they say. Retrieve facts at request time, and fine-tune for behavior.

ar-EG.title: إمتى RAG وإمتى Fine-tuning؟ ليه الـ Fine-tuning مش الطريقة لتعليم الموديل مستنداتك
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ training على مستنداتك بيعلّم الموديل أسلوبها، مش اللي مكتوب فيها بشكل يُعتمد عليه. هات المعلومة وقت الطلب، واعمل fine-tuning للسلوك.

sources.title: Ovadia et al., Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs, arXiv:2312.05934

import sys
import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
QUESTION = "How many weeks of parental leave do we get?"
employee = NS(id="emp_311", groups={"all-staff"})


def search_handbook(question, user, k=5):
    pages = [NS(source="kb://hr/parental-leave@v7", title="Parental leave",
                text="Employees get 16 weeks of paid parental leave.", audience="all-staff")]
    return [p for p in pages if p.audience in user.groups][:k]


def _create(*, model, max_tokens, messages, system=None, **kwargs):
    content = messages[-1]["content"]
    results = [c for c in content if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("type") == "search_result"]
    thinking = NS(type="thinking", thinking="")
    if not results:
        return NS(content=[thinking, NS(type="text", text="Usually 12 weeks.", citations=None)],
                  stop_reason="end_turn")
    cite = NS(type="search_result_location", source=results[0]["source"],
              title=results[0]["title"], search_result_index=0)
    return NS(content=[thinking, NS(type="text", text="You get 16 weeks of paid leave.",
                                    citations=[cite])], stop_reason="end_turn")


class _Anthropic:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.messages = NS(create=_create)


sys.modules["anthropic"] = NS(Anthropic=_Anthropic)
